# Use Atlassian Rovo MCP Server

Atlassian Rovo MCP Server is a cloud-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP)
server that gives your AI tools secure, real-time access to your data
across Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and other Atlassian apps.

Connect Rovo MCP and your AI client can query, create, and update your
Atlassian data using natural language prompts.
